title: What to expect from Password and Account Rules

question.author: member_179
question.body: I am checking my CloudBox setup. Which documented details matter for password and account rules?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Security documentation says: Repeated failed login attempts trigger a temporary lockout and an email notification. Account passwords must be at least 12 characters and cannot appear in known breach lists. Password resets are handled by verified email. The Security panel of the web app lists all active sessions and lets you sign out individual devices. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
